query: How does the Lily to Adriana handoff work in the AI bot system? I want to build a two-agent qualifier and closer for Facebook Messenger.
expected_behavior: Explains Lily's role as qualifier: collects 6 data points one at a time
Lists the 6 data points: name, address, timeline, condition, motivation, price
Explains handoff trigger: all 6 points collected + handoff phrase
Describes Adriana's role as closer: anchors price, pushes for phone number
Details Adriana's state machine: intro → anchoring → phone_collected → closing
Mentions novation pivot when seller objects to cash price
References bilingual support and DNC detection
